companyFieldUpdates.description: Danskammer Energy, LLC owns and operates a 532 MW, four-unit natural-gas-fired generating station in Newburgh, New York that supplies energy, capacity and ancillary services to NYISO. Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund II led the acquisition that closed on December 27, 2017 and retained voting control through Danskammer Investments LLC; the bankruptcy schedules attribute 81.79% of HoldCo shares to that vehicle, while the economics among Tiger affiliates are not publicly disclosed. The company entered Chapter 11 on June 10, 2026 and continued operating as a debtor-in-possession and NYISO interim service provider while pursuing a Section 363 sale. No buyer, completed sale, permanent retirement or Tiger exit was public by August 19, 2026. The separate proposed Energy Center repowering was denied, its applications were withdrawn in 2024, and it was not built.
